title: Data Scientist / ML Researcher
text: Data scientist skilled in Python, machine learning, deep learning, data analysis, pandas, numpy and predictive modeling. Experienced in feature engineering, hyperparameter tuning, scikit-learn, PyTorch, and deploying models to cloud environments.

title: Front-End Web Developer
text: Front-end web developer experienced in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Bootstrap and responsive web design. Proficient in Redux, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, REST API integration, and modern web application development.

title: DevOps & Cloud Engineer
text: DevOps engineer experienced in Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, Jenkins and cloud deployment. Skilled in Terraform, AWS, Linux system administration, microservices monitoring with Prometheus and Grafana.

title: Software Testing & QA Engineer
text: Software testing engineer skilled in manual testing, automation testing using Selenium and bug tracking tools. Proficient with JIRA, Postman API testing, test plan creation, regression testing, and CI/CD quality gates.

title: Graphic & UI/UX Designer
text: Graphic designer experienced in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, UI/UX design, branding and digital media design. Proficient in Figma, typography, color theory, wireframing, prototyping, and design systems.

title: High School Mathematics Teacher
text: High school mathematics teacher experienced in curriculum planning, student assessment, classroom management and interactive teaching. Skilled in STEM education, pedagogy, student engagement, and parent-teacher communication.

title: Cybersecurity & Network Engineer
text: Network security specialist experienced in cybersecurity, firewalls, intrusion detection systems and network monitoring. Skilled in SIEM, vulnerability assessment, penetration testing, Cisco routers, VPNs, and zero-trust security.

title: HR Manager & Talent Acquisition
text: HR Manager with expertise in talent acquisition, recruitment life cycle, employee onboarding, payroll, performance management, labor law compliance, HR policies, conflict resolution, and employee relations.

title: Financial Analyst & Investment Specialist
text: Financial analyst with strong background in financial modeling, equity valuation, budgeting, cash flow forecasting, variance analysis, Excel VBA, capital markets, risk management, and financial reporting.

title: Executive Chef & Kitchen Director
text: Executive Chef with over 10 years of experience in fine dining, culinary arts, menu engineering, kitchen management, HACCP food safety standards, inventory control, and culinary team leadership.
